title: ticks should record that it owns cloud/sandbox and that ticfac vendors it at e1146e6d (tick g69)
body: ticfac tick 5bp decided the authority: ticks owns cloud/sandbox, ticfac vendors it as a pinned copy with sandbox.pin.json at ref e1146e6da773e2b7d6ad9178faa1fd367466d5b8, verified offline on every test run and byte-for-byte against ticks at that ref in CI. ticks tick g69 ('decide the record for cloud/sandbox') should record this on ticks' side, so an editor of ticks' copy knows a consumer follows at a pin and the change must be adoptable, and so the two trackers do not later record contradictory decisions about the same tree.
